client_id.label: Yandex OAuth Client ID
client_id.description: Create your own application at https://oauth.yandex.ru/ with the cloud_api:disk.read permission, then enter its Client ID.

client_secret.label: Yandex OAuth Client Secret
client_secret.description: Enter the Client secret of the same Yandex OAuth application. Leave blank during reconfiguration to keep the stored secret.

folder_id.label: Root folder to scan
folder_id.description: Yandex Disk path to scan, for example disk:/Music. Leave as 'root' to scan the whole disk.

user.title: Connect Yandex Disk
user.description: Enter the credentials of your own Yandex OAuth application, choose the content type and optionally limit scanning to a folder.

device_login.title: Authorize Yandex Disk
device_login.description: Open the verification URL shown below, enter the code and allow read-only access to Yandex Disk. A fresh code is shown automatically if it expires.
device_login.progress_text: Waiting for you to confirm access on Yandex...

abort.login_denied: The Yandex authorization request was denied.

errors.connection_error: Could not contact Yandex OAuth. Check the connection and try again.
errors.oauth_error: Yandex rejected the OAuth request. Verify the Client ID, Client secret and application permissions.

manifest.description: Stream music, audiobooks and podcasts stored on Yandex Disk
